purpose: check whether historical sampler grouping can prevent within-rank padding on mixed questions, to assess relevance of previous constructed-batch diagnostic
configuration: installed TRL RepeatSampler and Accelerate BatchSamplerShard, num_generations=8, per-device batch4, world size2, steps_per_generation=1, seeds42/43/44, each dataset length; first256 paired batches
metrics: counts of mixed prompt IDs within each rank and mismatched groups between ranks, aggregate only
limits: simulates sampler/sharding on installed versions and configuration; not a captured historical training batch, no model generation or gradient; CPU 1h timeout 1GB guard
